population: ALL 75 open, unmerged PR(s) on this repo, graded on hours since the last commit to the head branch. Drafts INCLUDED -- the convention here is 'DRAFT PR, the manager merges', so a draft is the normal hand-back shape. 0 row(s) were undateable and are excluded from the worst-wait figure.
